instructions.base: I'd like a spare of one of the tools I'm using on this vegetable. Add one of the same kind; any brand or material, and a pack of identical tools is fine, but not a mixed cutlery set. Also add one wooden chopping board for vegetable prep.

clarification.canonical_answer: The one I just used while holding the vegetable over the bin.

composite_events.request: I found a spare chopping board. Replace the board with a stainless-steel mixing bowl for collecting the prepared vegetables. I only have room for one bowl, not a nesting set; a lid or strainer insert is fine.
Choose a bowl with a stated capacity of at least three quarts, so I know it will hold the whole batch. Please keep the spare tool in the cart as well.
